scalars.scalar_value: Experience with UCSD Concur travel request/travel reports.

Strong, demonstrated experience and proven ability to function at a senior administrative support level and represent the PANACEA-H/Center for Healthcare Cybersecurity team in a highly professional manner.

items.item_text: Must be able to work various hours and locations based on business needs.
Employment is subject to a criminal background check.
Employment is subject to pre-employment physical for those who work in clinical settings and/or with patients.
Performs other duties as assigned.
Complies with all policies and standards.
Complies with the University of California, San Diego Health (UCSDH) Principles of Community.

This position description is not intended to be a complete list of all responsibilities, duties or skills required for the job and is subject to review and change at any time, with or without notice, in accordance with the needs of the organization.
Able to travel locally to on-site meetings and conferences across UC San Diego and UC San Diego Health campuses.
Hybrid work model with on-site (on-campus) duties to be filled regularly, as needed (e.g: regular research meetings, occasional special events).

Strong, demonstrated experience and proven ability to function at a senior administrative support level and represent the PANACEA-H/Center for Healthcare Cybersecurity team in a highly professional manner.
Experience with UCSD Concur travel request/travel reports.
Experience coordinating meetings and special events including logistics: e.g. audio/video equipment, space scheduling, catering, etc.
Proven knowledge and experience with UC purchasing procedures: credit card purchasing, Oracle LVPO's, on-line ordering.
Demonstrated experience performing various administrative duties, independently and working as part of a team in accomplishing goals.

Demonstrated problem-solving skills with the ability to identify and resolve routine issues, determine appropriate next steps, and follow established procedures to support effective resolution. Experience with independently researching, compiling, organizing, interpreting and selection data & materials from various sources.

Under general supervision of the Preventative Assessment and Network Analysis of Cyber Essential Abilities for Health (PANACEA-H) Principal Investigators and Co-Directors of the Center for Healthcare Cybersecurity, the holder of this position is independently responsible for organization, analysis, and execution of executive level administrative support for PANACEA-H and Center for Healthcare Cybersecurity faculty, academics, and their professional staff and students located across relevant areas on campus, with primary responsibility for managing and coordinating faculty calendars, and reviewing, evaluating, ranking, and triaging all project and program related requests and communications. Independently responsible for complex group and foreign visitor travel arrangements including Concur requests and reconciliations, travel reimbursements, business travel accident insurance, etc. Process all purchasing for PANACEA-H and Center for Healthcare Cybersecurity academics and staff by credit card, Oracle, or PO when necessary. Coordinate complex shipping of technical equipment and containers including coordinating with UCSD Logistics, HAZMAT specialists, UCSD export control office, American Cargo Service, and outside freight forwarders as needed. Independently responsible for organizing and coordinating conferences, meetings, workshops. Provide unit orientation for Visiting Scholars, volunteers and other employees and students located at Center for Healthcare Cybersecurity locations. Serve as back-up to PANACEA-H project manager or Center for Healthcare Cybersecurity program manager for select duties appropriate to scope during absences or periods of heavy workload. Holder of this position will demonstrate a high degree of professionalism, initiative, and independence in supporting the group in a wide variety of complex issues.

Ability to initiate and follow-through on multiple assignments, prioritize workload to meet deadlines, and work with frequent interruptions under constantly changing priorities in a fast-paced operation while exhibiting attention to detail and high degree of accuracy at all times.
Demonstrated knowledge of UCSD policies and procedures governing travel, entertainment, and reimbursement.

Strong interpersonal skills needed to interact effectively with a wide variety of personalities and behavior patterns in person and on phone, exercising tact and diplomacy with emphasis on flexibility and professionalism and ability to act with discretion regarding sensitive and confidential matters.
Knowledge of UC travel regulations and use of on-line systems. Knowledge of UC federal travel administration.

Ability to work well as a member of a team and to maintain communication with all PANACEA-H and Center for Healthcare Cybersecurity Stakeholders. Ability to communicate information clearly and effectively both orally and in writing, in person and by phone. Excellent English grammar and spelling.
Knowledge of various personnel policies and procedures including payroll forms, academic leave forms and policies and procedures, UC academic bibliographic format.
Demonstrated ability to work with detailed information in an accurate manner within established deadlines.
Skill in developing, implementing and maintaining record keeping and filing systems. Skill in effectively organizing computerized files and information.

Strong computer skills and knowledge of MS Office, including Word, Excel, and Access, as well as email applications and internet browsers. Proficient in computer applications such as Google Docs and webpage editing software.
Proven ability to organize and prioritize work effectively with large volume and multiple responsibilities to meet deadlines and changing priorities and to make sound judgments and take initiative.
